q: What is your career goals for next years?
a:
My career goal for the next years is to build a successful career in the aviation sector. I aim to become a senior cabin crew member at Katar Airlines.

I want to learn more about aviation and improve my skills in communication and teamwork.

Additionally, I hope to take on more respobsibilities, such as training new staff. My goal is to be valuable part of Katar Airlines and contribute to its success.
